Load and filter speeches

Source: R/speeches.R
parl_speeches.Rd

Returns the speeches of the Parliament of Catalonia (1932-1938), one row per speech, with the variables described in the codebook plus four derived columns: paraules (number of words), mes ("YYYY-MM"), govern (government in office on that date, from parl_governments()), es_govern (whether party_data was in that government; NA when there is no party, before the first statutory government of 1932-12-19, or while the government was suspended) and circumscripcio (electoral district, for MPs).

Usage

parl_speeches(
  year = NULL,
  from = NULL,
  to = NULL,
  person = NULL,
  party = NULL,
  session = NULL,
  side = c("all", "government", "opposition"),
  office = NULL,
  spoken_only = TRUE,
  include_chair = TRUE,
  include_doubtful = TRUE,
  text = TRUE
)

Arguments

year

Integer vector of years (1932-1938).

from, to

Dates (or "YYYY-MM-DD" strings) delimiting the period.

person

Character vector of persons: nom_sencer or id_persona. Values that match no person exactly are matched as a case- and accent-insensitive substring of nom_sencer.

party

Character vector of party acronyms, matched against party_data (party on the date of the speech).

session

Character vector of session identifiers (sessio).

side

"all" (default), "government" or "opposition", based on es_govern.

office

NULL (default, no filter), TRUE (only speeches delivered in an office), FALSE (only speeches delivered as an MP) or a character vector of offices: either headings as they appear in the carrec column (e.g. "CONSELLER DE CULTURA") or harmonised labels from the carrec column of parl_offices() (e.g. "Conseller de Cultura"), which match all their heading variants.

spoken_only

Logical. If TRUE (default), drop readings by the secretary and anonymous headings, which are not speeches by a person.

include_chair

Logical. If FALSE, drop speeches delivered while chairing the session (resolucio == "presidencia_sessio").

include_doubtful

Logical. If FALSE, drop speeches flagged in assignacio_dubtosa.

text

Logical. Include the text column (default TRUE).

Value

A tibble.

Details

Metadata are bundled with the package. The text column requires the text to be downloaded once with parl_download().

Examples

parl_speeches(year = 1934, party = "LR", text = FALSE)
#> # A tibble: 416 × 25
#>      any sessio      data       ordre pagina orador orador_cru carrec nom_sencer
#>    <int> <chr>       <date>     <int>  <int> <chr>  <chr>      <chr>  <chr>     
#>  1  1934 DSPC_1934-… 1934-01-05     1      4 DURAN… DURAN I V… NA     Lluís Dur…
#>  2  1934 DSPC_1934-… 1934-01-05     3      4 DURAN… DURAN I V… NA     Lluís Dur…
#>  3  1934 DSPC_1934-… 1934-01-05     5      5 DURAN… DURAN I V… NA     Lluís Dur…
#>  4  1934 DSPC_1934-… 1934-01-05     6      6 VALLS… VALLS I T… NA     Ferran Va…
#>  5  1934 DSPC_1934-… 1934-01-05     7      6 DURAN… DURAN I V… NA     Lluís Dur…
#>  6  1934 DSPC_1934-… 1934-01-05     9      7 VALLE… VALLÈS I … NA     Joan Vall…
#>  7  1934 DSPC_1934-… 1934-01-05    10      7 DURAN… DURAN I V… NA     Lluís Dur…
#>  8  1934 DSPC_1934-… 1934-01-05    12      8 DURAN… DURAN I V… NA     Lluís Dur…
#>  9  1934 DSPC_1934-… 1934-01-05    14      8 DURAN… DURAN I V… NA     Lluís Dur…
#> 10  1934 DSPC_1934-… 1934-01-05    16      8 DURAN… DURAN I V… NA     Lluís Dur…
#> # ℹ 406 more rows
#> # ℹ 16 more variables: party <chr>, party_data <chr>, id_persona <chr>,
#> #   es_diputat <lgl>, resolucio <chr>, assignacio_dubtosa <lgl>,
#> #   es_carrec <lgl>, es_anonim <lgl>, acotacio <chr>, n_car <int>,
#> #   te_taula <lgl>, paraules <int>, mes <chr>, govern <chr>, es_govern <lgl>,
#> #   circumscripcio <chr>
parl_speeches(person = "Companys", include_chair = FALSE, text = FALSE)
